construction.implementation_origin: New isolated implementation built from the supplied specification.

shared_schema.input: Strict JSON object: schema_version, synthetic, work_order, sensor, telemetry_csv, inspections, completed_steps, maintenance_logs. Example is the complete reference shape.
shared_schema.work_order: ERP/MES-style JSON containing fictitious order/asset/product, positive integer quantity and planned/in_progress status.
shared_schema.telemetry: Embedded time-series CSV with exact timestamp,work_order_id,asset_id,sensor_id,value,unit header. Strict chronology, timezone-aware timestamps, finite measurements and consistent identifiers required.
shared_schema.units_and_tolerances: Temperature degC or vibration mm/s; safety bounds enclose ordered operating tolerance bounds. Diameter inspection uses mm with positive ordered tolerances. Boundaries are inclusive.
shared_schema.quality_traceability: Inspection and decision identifiers, inspector, timestamp, rationale, order and asset links required. Recorded pass/fail must match measured value and tolerance. Demonstrates ISO 9001-style traceability only; not certification.
shared_schema.output: Versioned status=ok, synthetic=true envelope retains validated input and parsed telemetry, adding guided, journey and sentiment objects in sequence. Error output is status=error with error text.
shared_schema.validation_layer: validate_input and validate_state are shared by all stages; boundary validation re-derives deterministic handoffs to reject stale, incomplete or altered outputs.

cross_stage_handoffs: Guided setup validates complete manufacturing context, tracks prerequisite-compliant completions and carries quality decision IDs.

Journey consumes validated guided state and uses actual progress to choose two sequentially feasible recommendations. It carries quality decision IDs, maintenance text, inspection failures and sensor excursions.
Sentiment consumes the validated journey signals and steps, preserving source IDs, decision IDs and order linkage while attaching explainable sentiment, severity priority and escalation routing.

behavior.guided: verify_work_order -> verify_telemetry -> review_inspections; duplicates, unknown or out-of-order completions rejected.
behavior.journey: First two unmet prerequisite-satisfied actions from onboarding plus review_maintenance, request_human_release, monitor_next_cycle. The second recommendation is conditional on completing the first; recommendations never mark work done or authorize machine operation.
behavior.sentiment: Exact case-insensitive alphabetic English token matching; (positive-negative)/max(1,total matches). Includes matched tokens and sorted lexicons.
behavior.prioritization: Human escalation first; severity rank * 10 plus negative sentiment magnitude, descending; source-qualified ID is deterministic tie breaker. Positive wording never downgrades safety.
behavior.human_escalation: Safety-critical logs, safety-bound excursions, and critical severity route to human_safety_review; no automatic release or machine control.
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic. Six temperatures generated with random.Random(80), gauss(64,1.2), rounded to three decimals. Fictitious asset and sensor identifiers, invented maintenance log and quality inspection.
behavior.cli: One JSON object to stdout; success exit 0, validation/file/JSON errors exit 2. No external calls or mutable global progress.

included: Shared strict schema and boundary validation
Prerequisite-driven onboarding and conditional two-step discovery
Transparent lexicon sentiment and severity-aware prioritization
Demonstrative manufacturing traceability, units and safety escalation
excluded: Live providers or optional LLM integration
Actual human notification, machine control or automated quality release
Free-form unit conversion, negation or sarcasm inference

unit_tests.coverage: All three stages, deterministic behavior, nonmutation, both cross-stage handoffs, tampering, prerequisites, traceability, tolerances, units, nonfinite values, chronological CSV, safety escalation, neutral and mixed sentiment, severity ranking, empty logs and CLI success/error paths.

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok and guided, journey, sentiment outputs
cli.error_paths: Missing file, missing argument, malformed JSON, duplicate fields and invalid schema return status error with exit 2.
